I've created the visual optimization file at `outputs/07_chart_edits.json`. Here's a summary of the edits:

**12 slides optimized with:**

| Slide | Visual Type | Key Optimization |
|-------|-------------|------------------|
| SL01 | Horizontal process flow | 4 stages with exit ramps, "Zero Budget" entry callout |
| SL02 | Bar chart | 2 bars only (25%→50%), "2×" annotation, no gridlines |
| SL03 | Quote with connector | Single bold quote linked to proposal alignment |
| SL04 | Linear flow with header | 4-step pipeline under "Human-in-the-Loop" governance banner |
| SL05 | Achievement card | Large "#1" focal number with badge visual |
| SL06 | Comparison table | Icon-based (✓/✗), highlighted "This Proposal" column |
| SL07 | Tier progression | 4 ascending tiers with single "Exit available" footnote |
| SL08 | Value mapping table | 3 rows × 2 columns, entity-to-value mapping |
| SL09 | Layered stack | 4 numbered security layers, "No public token" callout |
| SL10 | Responsibility matrix | 3 columns with checkmarks for accountability |
| SL11 | Investment summary | Highlighted "Time only" entry, returns listed separately |
| SL12 | Action timeline | 4 milestones with exit icons, "Designate owners" callout |

**Consistent principles applied:**
- Maximum 2-3 colors per visual
- Direct labels instead of legends/axes
- Icon-based values (✓/✗) where applicable
- Single focal point per visual
- All specs are Slidev-renderable (tables, flows, charts)
